name: second-brain
description: Shopify theme development pipeline adapted to run as a Slack-resident teammate via Claude Tag. Fork of shopify-theme-toolkit: same clarify -> plan -> execute -> assess -> fix flow, same standards skills and agents, with every skill model-invocable from natural-language requests, execute restricted to the pipeline, and artifacts committed to the working branch so work survives sandbox turnover. Includes /grill-me, two-way ClickUp via /clickup, design intake via /figma, and roadmap decomposition via /brainstorm.
